summary: The terminal interface wraps a styled word and the punctuation after it together, so a link or a doc/ reference never leaves its full stop or comma alone on the next row

schema.detail: No database schema, version or stored data changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Display only: the terminal interface's text wrapping keeps a word whole across style changes. No client, API or stored-data change.
